standard.summary: 按目标模块分别设置 LoRA alpha
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Sets the LoRA alpha per target module
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 按目标模块分别设置 LoRA alpha。每行「目标模块=alpha」（如 attention.qkv=16），或 JSON（如 {"attention.qkv": 16}）。

advanced_en.principle: Sets LoRA alpha per target module. One "target module=alpha" per line (e.g. attention.qkv=16), or JSON (e.g. {"attention.qkv": 16}).
